description: Presidential secretariat - Pore (Davatagaha Kumbura) D/S/Division Kaduwela, Colombo District for Athurugiriya New Town Development Project (Under Urban Development Project)
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for an urban development project. It declares that specific land described in detail (including boundaries, lot numbers, and location) is urgently required for the Athurugiriya New Town Development Project under the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act. While it mentions the President and a Minister, this is only to establish the legal authority for the land declaration, not to announce government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core subject matter is land-related, fitting Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
